results.title: Trans Cyclist Veronica Ivy Now Stealing Women’s Titles in a Second Sport
results.description: A transgender cyclist who identifies as a woman is now knocking women out of winning titles in a second sport. Veronica Ivy has already won a string of women’s pro cycling titles as far back as 2018.
